## Fitting: parameter recovery

A synthetic "real" image rendered from a truth table (three classes changed, 4-look speckle per 30 m cell) is fitted from the starting table with `validation.fit` (single-bounce basis plus re-rendered multi-bounce part, interior 90 m blocks without layover or shadow, median-absolute-dB objective). Recovered means |n - n_true| <= 0.15 and k within 10%; or, where the data cannot constrain n (objective rises by less than 0.1 dB at n +- 0.5, e.g. a flat lake seen over a few degrees of incidence), that the fitted parameters predict the same backscatter as the true ones to within 0.1 dB.
